bio.text: Bob Harvie is the Democratic nominee for Pennsylvania's 1st Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having defeated Lucia Simonelli in the May 19, 2026 primary.
According to his campaign website, he was elected to the Bucks County Board of Commissioners in November 2019 and sworn in on January 6, 2020.
The campaign site says he was named chair of the board in January 2022, re-elected in November 2023, and named chair again in January 2025.
